items.title: Remark42: Rate limit bypass via unconditional trust of X-Forwarded-For/X-Real-IP headers in direct-internet deployment
items.summary: ### Summary Remark42 applied chi's `middleware.RealIP` globally, trusting `True-Client-IP` / `X-Real-IP` / `X-Forwarded-For` headers without verifying the request came from a trusted proxy. The per-IP rate limiters key on the overwritten `r.RemoteAddr`, so any client can bypass every per-IP rate limiter by rotating spoofed IP headers. items.title: Pocket ID: The client credentials grant allows any OIDC client to obtain tokens for arbitrary audiences
items.summary: ## Summary The client credentials grant (`grant_type=client_credentials`) does not validate the resource parameter before embedding it as the aud claim in the issued JWT. Any authenticated OIDC client can obtain a Pocket ID-signed access token claiming authorization for any arbitrary audience, including other registered OIDC clients. There is no check that the requested audience is a registered resource server, and no check that the requesting client has been granted permission to access it. ##

items.title: tsParticles: Unbounded HTTP Request Body Buffering in @tsparticles/mcp-server Leads to Remote DoS
items.summary: ### Summary The HTTP server mode of `@tsparticles/mcp-server` accumulates all incoming request body chunks into an in-memory `Buffer[]` array with no size limit before calling `JSON.parse`. An unauthenticated remote attacker can stream an arbitrarily large body to `POST /mcp`, exhausting the Node.js process memory and causing a Denial of Service. items.title: traQ: Privilege escalation by OAuth prompt=none request
items.summary: In OAuth2 silent authorization (`prompt=none`), when the `scope` parameter was empty or omitted, all scopes registered for the OAuth client became eligible for issuance. However, the prior consent check was performed against the empty requested scope set. items.title: isomorphic-git: Path traversal via a ".." tree-entry name writes files outside the working directory on clone/checkout
items.summary: ### Summary isomorphic-git's tree parser (`src/models/GitTree.js`) validates each entry name only against the path separators `/` and `\`. items.summary: ### Summary `git.checkout` writes working-tree files through a directory **symlink** without checking the leading path, so a malicious repository can write **outside the intended working directory**. items.title: fastapi-code-generator: Import-time RCE via route path -> unescaped @app.get('...') decorator
items.summary: ### Summary fastapi-code-generator (koxudaxi) emits the OpenAPI path into the generated main.py route decorator as a single-quoted string literal (`@app.get('/u/ /x')`) without escaping the `'`. A `'` in the path closes the decorator string and, via concatenation, injects a live expression that the decorator argument evaluates when main.py is imported (the ASGI server imports it at startup) -- code execution, no request needed.
